label: prf:bond-order-eq-jet-degree
title: Proof that body order equals jet degree
html:
Step 1 — the cluster sub-braid sits at its jet degree. The canonical atomic braid atom_braid_word_3A builds \mathcal{B}_K by concatenating one 3-strand block per nucleon and inserting the inter-nucleon crossings. Adding a nucleon to an (n-1)-cluster appends its block and the crossings binding it to the cluster, raising the Gröbner--Shirshov normal-form length by a fixed increment (prop:gb-spectral-sequence). Reading this length through the jet-prefix order (prop:jet-prefix-gb-filtration) places the n-nucleon cluster sub-word at jet vertical degree n.

Step 2 — the graded component is the cluster term. Because the GS filtration is exhaustive and the spectral sequence collapses at E_2, the associated-graded \mathrm{gr}_n is spanned by exactly the normal forms of filtration degree n, i.e. the n-nucleon cluster contributions. No contribution escapes a finite cluster degree (every sub-word has finite GS length), so the filtration is exhaustive.

Conclusion. Summing the graded components reconstructs the binding, and by Steps 1--2 the degree-n component equals the n-body term: \sum_n(\text{\(n\)-body term})=\sum_n\mathrm{gr}_n. The Lean witness QOU.Mass.bodyorder_eq_jet_total packages the graded-match (Step 1--2) and exhaustiveness as the structure hypothesis and extracts the body-order = jet-graded sum identity. \qquad\blacksquare
